mount: create only on explicit intent or when surface is actually visible
choose low-power unless measured need says otherwise
initialize fallback UI before async asset load
active: ResizeObserver or equivalent owns canvas sizing
no-op or pause when parent surface is occluded/inactive
respect reduced-motion and profile motion settings
avoid continuous animation when a static render is sufficient
teardown: forceContextLoss for repeatedly mounted renderer where safe
remove event listeners and script-owned references
failure: never trap navigation because WebGL fails

active: pause expensive simulation/render when 2D app panel or settings covers world
teardown: page-lifetime renderer may not require component teardown, but navigation architecture must prevent duplicate world renderers/contexts
performance: track draw calls, triangles, asset memory and long-session thermals on physical phones

migration_rule: M0 copies renderer behavior. Convergence is post-M0 and one surface at a time with visual/performance comparison.
